items.title: Angela Autumn – “Heavy Tobacco”
items.summary: About a month ago, Angela Autumn released "Mountain Stream," the lead single from her new album Believer. We liked that one a lot, so I'm happy to report she's got another tune out today. The Nashville-based artist, who also duetted with Deloyd Elze on the mirage-like country track "George Jones" this year, plays a raw, off-kilter version of roots rock that would go well with Zoh Amba's singer-songwriter material.
